The '''Jaresh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained at least three [[Planet/Legends|planets]]; on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the third planet the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Ree Shala]] established a base of operations.
